mappings.input_completeness: required input count and valid immutable input count
mappings.product_patterns: pattern references projected from tagged secondary_records
mappings.product_risk_posture: role security_posture plus fixed human authority
mappings.coverage: required and valid specialist input counts
mappings.evidence_quality: canonical evidence confidence with deterministic threshold label
mappings.release_readiness_input: decision-request presence mapped to advisory state; never a release decision
mappings.escalations: canonical decision request identifiers and required authorities

prohibited: model control of input inventory, completeness, envelope, routing, identity, integrity, or lineage
projection-time creation of findings, decisions, or confidence
representation of release_readiness_input as a release decision
